chunks: We have clarified through authentic reports that the birth of the Master of the Era (peace be upon him) was in the year two hundred and fifty-six.
And that his father (peace be upon him) passed away in the year two hundred and sixty, so at that time he was four years old.
So his age until the time of his emergence is what calculation dictates.
And that does not contradict the reports that have been narrated regarding the measure of his age, which differ in wording.
ai.seo_question: When was Imam Mahdi born and how old was he when his father passed away?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi establishes the Imam's birth in 256 A.H. and his age of four at his father's death in 260 A.H., providing a chronological baseline for the doctrine of *al-Umur al-Arba'a* (the four periods). He argues that the calculated lifespan reconciles seemingly contradictory narrations regarding his age, affirming the theological principle of *ghaybat al-kubra* and the Imam's enduring presence despite his occultation.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: We have previously, through authentic reports, narrated that the holy birth of Imam Mahdi (a.s) occurred in 256 A.H.
and his holy father passed away in 260 A.H. Thus the Imam was four years old at that time.
However, the age of the Imam till the time of his reappearance and advent is a number, which requires calculation

with the reports that are recorded about the age of the Imam at the time of reappearance [like reports, which say that he would appear like a man of forty] are differently worded, have no contradiction with reports, which will be mentioned in this section.
